invariants_acknowledged: One tier system: tenant-configurable revenue tiers seeded from ENTERPRISE/MID_MARKET/SMB/STARTUP (owner ruling A, 2026-10-07); no bronze/silver/gold/platinum, no points.
Tier is derived from revenue through domain resolveAccountTier; default config must reproduce today's 10M/1M/100k bands exactly and null revenue resolves to defaultTierKey ?? UNKNOWN.
accountTiers.update/resetToDefaults are ADMIN-only via adminTenantProcedure (no OWNER role exists); every query goes through prismaWithTenant with tenantId from context.
Config writes are delete+recreate inside one $transaction guarded by an optimistic updatedAt check; never skipDuplicates; P2002 maps to CONFLICT (playbook §5).

Every Boolean toggle is category 1 (wired): notifyOwnerOnUpgrade/notifyOwnerOnDowngrade drive account_tier_changed notifications from account.update/updateRevenue; hysteresis/overrides dropped (playbook §8).
Migration is Class A: two new tables with CHECKs (18-colour allowlist, minRevenue >= 0, key regex, key <> UNKNOWN) and RLS USING+WITH CHECK; no DML; production only via gated prisma migrate deploy.

AccountCard, AccountDetail, AccountHierarchy, HierarchyTab and the sidebar tier links must all read the one configuration; TIER_CONFIG/TIER_GRADIENTS/DEFAULT_TIER_OPTIONS are removed and /accounts?tier= filters server-side.

Page follows the module-settings playbook: PageHeader + 12-col bento, SectionHeader action slot, EmptyState entity=rules phase=passive without inner CTA, Save disabled when !isDirty||isSaving||hasConflict, Material Symbols only.
